task_rules: This is a planning contract, not live release state. DP1/DP2 captures and documentation intake are unmeasured at authoring; current evidence will live in the permanent transition index.

Capture and review DP1 before surviving implementation, including BASE.2. BASE.2 and BASE.3 establish the bounded accounting bootstrap and do not wait for their own completion; every original M-task waits for accepted BASE.3. Before closing BASE.3, account for the bootstrap's own contributions as well. A version string or historical planning ancestor does not identify DP1.

For every actual accepted contribution, including unplanned fixes and generated-surface changes, supply stable permanent release-impact record IDs or separately reviewed no-user-impact and no-documentation-impact reasons.

Describe observable before/after behavior, affected audiences/workflows/platforms and command/API/config/schema/capability surfaces; bind claims to permanent anchors, exact implementation subjects and retained evidence.

Select justified migration dispositions (automatic, manual, rebuild, no action, or unsupported); reuse format break notes and actual migration operations, with prerequisites, exact recipe, expected result, verification and honest recovery limits.

Track affected documentation topics immediately, even before the documentation worker's output arrives. Bind concrete pages/source anchors after intake; cover added topics, removals and generated documentation as well as edited existing pages.

Keep the temporary task-to-change bridge separate from permanent release/change authority. M-02 adopts the same bootstrap record IDs and non-normative payloads; it must not create a second history or feed observations into intent/work identity.
Central review checks release/documentation impact along with the diff before accepting a contribution. Candidate records, a passing renderer or a worker report do not grant acceptance.

Record corrections, supersession and reverts explicitly. Final drafts describe the net accepted DP1-to-DP2 behavior; retain historical evidence without instructing users to follow abandoned intermediate migrations.

At each workstream boundary reconcile actual accepted changes and interface/capability deltas with records; all gaps need repair or an explicit evidence-backed disposition. Task counts and Git titles alone are not coverage.

Use the supplied documentation baseline, current authored documentation and accepted product changes for a three-way update. A missing intake blocks exact documentation editing/final proof, not independent product work.

DP2 remains a candidate until the campaign scaffold is absent, permanent checks and migration/documentation rehearsals pass, and the exact final product/docs subject is sealed. Release metadata attestation cannot hide later product or documentation changes.
workstream_acceptance: Reconcile actual accepted contributions and interface/capability deltas with permanent release-impact evidence and separate justified user/documentation dispositions; carry unresolved documentation updates explicitly to the final documentation gate.
closure_acceptance: Retain a reviewed DP1-to-DP2 migration guide, updated documentation, complete change/documentation coverage and reproducible evidence outside campaign scaffolding; seal the final DP2 product/docs capture and rerun permanent proof after scaffold removal.
